product.title: A Tree Grows in Brooklyn and Maggie-Now Betty Smith Hardcover Omnibus Dust Jacket
product.description:
A Tree Grows in Brooklyn and Maggie-Now — Betty Smith

Two Betty Smith novels collected in one illustrated hardcover volume, published by Harper & Row. Includes the illustrated tan-and-blue dust jacket shown in the photographs.

Condition

Acceptable vintage condition. Dust jacket has a prominent tear down from the front top edge, additional edge tears, chipping and paper losses, rubbing, fading, staining and worn spine ends. The rear jacket flap has substantial wear and small losses along its edge. Book edges show age toning and spotting. A loose thread is visible near the rear hinge. The book has not been inspected page by page; binding strength and interior completeness have not been fully checked. Please review all photographs.

Details

  • Author: Betty Smith
  • Two novels in one book: A Tree Grows in Brooklyn and Maggie-Now
  • Publisher: Harper & Row, Publishers; New York, Evanston, and London
  • English-language illustrated hardcover; printed in the United States
  • Undated omnibus printing. The photographed copyright page for A Tree Grows in Brooklyn states 1943 and 1947; these are not represented as this omnibus printing’s publication date.
  • Edition and book-club status unconfirmed; no first-edition claim
  • Approximate comparable-copy dimensions: 8½ × 5¾ × 1¾ inches; not individually measured

Included

One hardcover containing both novels, with its worn dust jacket. This is one book, not a two-book lot.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
